facts.statement: Daohugoupterus is a genus of pterosaur found in the Middle to Late Jurassic Daohugou Beds of the Tiaojishan Formation in Inner Mongolia, China.
facts.quote: Daohugoupterus is a genus of pterosaur from the Middle to Late Jurassic Daohugou Beds of the Tiaojishan Formation in Inner Mongolia, China.

facts.statement: Daohugoupterus was named and described in 2015 by Cheng Xin, Wang Xiaolin, Jiang Shunxing, and Alexander Wilhelm Armin Kellner.
facts.quote: Daohugoupterus was named and described in 2015 by Cheng Xin, Wang Xiaolin, Jiang Shunxing and Alexander Wilhelm Armin Kellner.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was acquired by the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology at Beijing through field work by Zhou Zhonghe and Li Yan at the village of Daohugou near Linglongta.
facts.quote: Through field work by Zhou Zhonghe and Li Yan, the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology at Beijing acquired a pterosaur specimen found at the village of Daohugou near Linglongta.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen includes parts of the torso, pectoral girdle, left humerus, coracoids, scapula, sternal plate, vertebrae, ribs, and the posterior skull and lower jaws.
facts.quote: This specimen includes part of the torso and pectoral girdle, the left humerus (upper arm bone), both coracoids, right scapula, the sternal plate, neck vertebrae, back vertebrae, ribs, and the posterior part of the skull and lower jaws.

facts.statement: Daohugoupterus is a small pterosaur with a humerus measuring 41.8 mm in length.
facts.quote: Daohugoupterus is a small pterosaur. The humerus is 41.8 mm long.

facts.statement: Two distinguishing traits considered possible autapomorphies are the nasal bones deeply invading the frontal bones and a sternal plate that is 2.5 times wider than it is long.
facts.quote: Two distinguishing traits were indicated, which were considered possible autapomorphies: the nasal bones deeply invade the frontal bones, and the sternal plate is broad, being 2.5 times wider than it is long.

facts.statement: Features such as short neck vertebrae, cervical ribs, and a quadrangular deltopectoral crest indicate Daohugoupterus was a relatively basal pterosaur outside the Pterodactyloidea.
facts.quote: The short neck vertebrae, presence of cervical ribs, and the form of the humerus with a quadrangular deltopectoral crest indicate that Daohugoupterus was a relatively basal pterosaur, outside of the Pterodactyloidea.

facts.statement: Daohugoupterus is classified as Pterosauria incertae sedis.
facts.quote: It was placed Pterosauria incertae sedis.

facts.statement: Daohugoupterus is a member of the Yanliao Biota and is the smallest of the three pterosaurs in that group, along with Jeholopterus and Pterorhynchus.
facts.quote: Daohugoupterus is a member of the Yanliao Biota, which also includes the pterosaurs Jeholopterus and Pterorhynchus; Daohugoupterus is the smallest of the three.

facts.statement: Daohugoupterus lived during the Callovian stage, between 165.3 and 161.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Callovian to Callovian (165.3 to 161.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: Daohugoupterus was described in 2014 by Xin Cheng and colleagues.
facts.quote: Daohugoupterus fue descrito en 2014 por Xin Cheng y colaboradores.

rejected.statement: The holotype is a partial skeleton with soft tissue impressions preserved on a plate and counterplate.
rejected.quote: This holotype is a partial skeleton with soft tissue impressions, compressed on a plate and counterplate.
